_comment: Tracked recurring issues found by the weekly calibration agent. Each issue has: id, theme (or category, or null for global), first_observed (run_id), last_observed (run_id), status (open|monitoring|resolved), description, evidence_runs (list of run_ids), actions_taken (list of {run_date, action}), recommendation_pending (bool, true if the fix requires a human edit to a forbidden/prompt-level field).

issues.description: Previously resolved collapse continues to hold; in fact weekday theme raw scores improved further starting ~Oct 1 (Monday raw mean roughly doubled, Tuesday/Wednesday/Thursday raw means rose 3-6x), closing most of the gap with weekend themes. No regression observed.

actions_taken.action: None—this requires human review of scoring_prompt and theme_description fields for Monday/Tuesday/Wednesday/Thursday, which are in the forbidden auto-edit list. No auto-tunable knob (min_score, holdover_threshold, keyword additions) will fix a near-zero mean_theme_score caused by a scoring failure. Flagging as open recurring issue pending human intervention.

None—this requires urgent human review and rewrite of scoring_prompt and theme_description fields for Monday/Tuesday/Wednesday/Thursday, which are in the forbidden auto-edit list. No auto-tunable knob (min_score, holdover_threshold, keyword additions) will fix a near-zero mean_theme_score caused by a fundamental scoring failure. The issue has persisted for 16 consecutive runs (July 26–August 9) with no sign of self-correction. The weekend themes' continued health proves the pipeline infrastructure is sound—this is a prompt-level bug, not a systemic failure. Flagging as critical open recurring issue requiring immediate human intervention.

The August 11 infrastructure change introducing dimensional scoring and relative scaling appears to have resolved the root cause. No auto-tunable knob changes were applied by calibration_agent—the fix came from human intervention on forbidden-territory scoring_prompt and dimensional weighting logic. Monitoring mean_theme_score_raw trends across next 3–4 runs to confirm sustained recovery.

issues.description: News remains the single worst-performing category on user-rated positive_pct (20.6% per-category in feedback, 79.4% bad), despite the Sep 23 max_slots.news cap to 10 and min_claude_score at ceiling-adjacent 25. Pipeline-side quality gate is dropping the vast majority of news candidates (8934 dropped vs 200 passed in this window), confirming the floor is working — the residual bad rate is a relevance/local scoring-prompt issue (news relevance histogram shows 12356/12729 articles in the 0-19 band) rather than a threshold problem.

actions_taken.action: None this run — the Sep 23 max_slots.news=10 cap needs more time to show its full effect in user feedback (which lags pipeline changes by 1-2 weeks). Avoiding further threshold tightening this run since threshold_sweep shows diminishing returns (25→30 costs 21.5% positive lost for 50.8% bad cut, disproportionately hitting 'interesting' articles).
